operations.summary: Read a user's certificate request defaults
operations.description: The default certificate type, DNS provider and CA prefilled into a new request. A user without saved defaults reads acme with revision 0. Tenant actors read their own scope; platform actors name the target tenant scope and user.

params.name: target_scope_id
params.description: Required for platform actors; tenant actors may only target their own scope.

responses.description: The user's defaults; ETag carries the revision.

fields.name: issuer
fields.description: Omitted when unset (the platform default applies).

responses.description: Invalid request or structurally invalid DNS/certificate data.
The active role lacks the required permission.
Resource absent or hidden by tenant isolation.

operations.summary: Save a user's certificate request defaults
operations.description: Compare-and-set on expected_revision (version_conflict when stale). dns_provider_id must be an enabled provider in the target scope (dns_resource_conflict otherwise). issuer is a known CA that is available now: a CA without platform EAB credentials is refused with certificate_issuer_unavailable (409) when saved, the same check an order create applies; uploaded defaults drop dns_provider_id and issuer. An order that falls back to a default CA whose credentials were removed later is still refused with certificate_issuer_unavailable when it is created.

fields.name: dns_provider_id
fields.description: Empty or null clears the default provider.

fields.name: issuer
fields.type: string: lets_encrypt / zerossl / google_trust /  / null | null: lets_encrypt / zerossl / google_trust /  / null
fields.description: Empty or null uses the platform default.

responses.description: Saved defaults; ETag carries the new revision.

fields.name: issuer
fields.description: Omitted when unset (the platform default applies).
